title: The Answer in the Faraway Future

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp. With the day's training finished,
I carefully log today's records for Aston Machan.
choice_data_list: Just during this training camp, she's really...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can clearly feel her growth. Comparing it with past data,
it's safe to call this deeply satisfying progress.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Having a chat with Mr. Computer, are we... Hmm?
Are those Machan's records?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Daily records. Lap times, stride cadence, little habits...
even things Machan never noticed herself.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: So many, many things... all preserved here.
choice_data_list: It's a Trainer's job, after all.
It's a Trainer's job, after all.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...So this is the Aston Machan
that you remember, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amused by how uncharacteristically stunned she looks,
I offer a cheerful reply.
choice_data_list: A new Machan is updated every single day.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: A new me, every day...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
(If that's true, then what kind of "Aston Machan"
remains in everyone's hearts?)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
(If "I" change day by day, then as many times as I am captured
and remembered... that's how many "mes" will remain.)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: (Countless, varied "Aston Machans.")

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
(Ah. That is... that feels like something so...
far beyond what the word 'remembering' could ever capture—)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It feels... so wonderfully colorful.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, look at the sky. Flowers will bloom in the sky soon.
And when they do, flowers will bloom across the sea, too.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Let us go. To the place we will one day arrive at.
For now, let us simply gaze upon it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It is so much cooler than during the day~.
And so very quiet. I feel like I can hear the waves so clearly.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Listening to the sound of the waves, I gaze out at the sea with Aston Machan.
There's no awkwardness even without words, and we space out for a while, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Remembering the sachet I gave her before, I decide to ask.
Did she end up putting anything inside it?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I haven't put anything inside yet.
But I always carry it with me. Even right now.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
What should I put inside?
What kind of scent should it have?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I hadn't thought of anything specific to put in it when I made it.
It wouldn't even necessarily have to be something scented—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Folding it to fit inside is not allowed.
Photos are best kept just as they are.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Something else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan says, gazing fixedly at me.
Pondering with an "hmmm," she looks at the sky, then at the sea.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
choice_data_list: Do you have any ideas, Machan?
Do you have any ideas, Machan?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I do. I am putting it in right now.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ah, look. The flowers are blooming.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shattering the silence, the sound of fireworks echoes across the air.
Their brilliant light reflects upon the sea, sparkling and glowing.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
From this angle, we cannot see the flowers on the sea~.
But surely, you would be able to see them from inside the ocean. Yes, surely.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...My lenses are full of vivid color right now.
Just like the sea reflecting the sky.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The time spent wondering what to put inside, the time spent watching the fireworks...
I have remembered every single bit of it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So every time I look at this sachet, I will remember.
This moment that only Machan and you know.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm? But if that's the case, it would become a memory sachet instead.
We should put a scent in it after all.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We shall search together. For a vivid fragrance,
warm and clear, just like today's memories.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing her say that, I finally understand
what Aston Machan had placed inside.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I want everyone in the world to remember "Aston Machan."
I want to leave my mark.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But now, I have one more wish.
It just slipped right in. Ehe.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Please keep remembering plenty of the Machan yet to come, too.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The me of today. The me of tomorrow. Capture the me that the world cannot fully hold,
reflecting and preserving me in your lenses, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Shh, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Whether you truly remembered me or not
is something I want to ask the Trainer of the far, far future.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If you've forgotten, we will open the sachet together.
Because if we do, I'm sure you will remember.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
What kind of expression the Machan of today was making.
What color you were showing, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Let us check again in the far-off future. Okay?
